arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Flanagan argued Congress enacted the protections to prevent spousal impoverishment.
Mr. Hagopian explained the resource-first rule applies to the community spouse.
Mr. Lamken addressed proposed regulations regarding calculation methods.

paragraphs: Does the statute mandate a specific calculation order for assets and income?

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: The outcome defines how states calculate Medicaid eligibility for institutionalized spouses. It determines whether a community spouse keeps more or less income. This directly affects access to long-term nursing home care.
